an8.85:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] samaṇoti bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
an8.85:1.4: bhisakkoti bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
an8.85:1.5: vedagū ti bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
an8.85:1.6: nimmalo ti bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
an8.85:1.7: vimalo ti bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsamābuddhassa. ñāṇī ti bhikkhave tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
an8.85:1.8: vimutto ti bhikkhave, tathāgatassetaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassāti.
